summary: Cross-Organization Collaboration feature testing completed. All 19 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified: Share button on Goal Detail page, ShareEntityDialog with all fields, Scope filter on Execution Hub page (All Projects, My Projects, Shared With Me), Share button on Campaigns page, Scope filter on Campaigns page. All features working correctly.

Share button on Goal Detail page.description: Share button (data-testid='share-goal-btn') appears for owned projects and opens ShareEntityDialog

ShareEntityDialog on Goal Detail.description: Dialog shows Admin Email input (data-testid='share-target-email'), Permission Level select (data-testid='share-permission-level'), Access Scope checkboxes (Tasks, Assets, Deliverables, Social Posts, Comments), Message textarea, Cancel and Share buttons

Scope filter on Execution Hub page.description: Scope filter (data-testid='scope-filter') shows three options: All Projects, My Projects, Shared With Me

Share button on Campaigns page.description: Share button (data-testid='share-campaign-{id}') appears for owned campaigns

ShareEntityDialog on Campaigns.description: Same dialog as Goal Detail with all fields working

Scope filter on Campaigns page.description: Scope filter (data-testid='filter-scope') shows: All Campaigns, My Campaigns, Shared With Me

Backend /api/share/entity endpoint.description: Accepts share requests, validates target_email, entity_type, prevents self-share

Backend /api/share/sent endpoint.description: Returns list of shares created by organization

Backend /api/share/received endpoint.description: Returns list of shares received by organization, supports entity_type filter

Backend /api/share/entity/{type}/{id}/ac.description: Returns access info for entities (owner or shared)

critical_code_review_comments: All sharing API endpoints properly implemented with validation
Frontend correctly displays scope filters and share buttons for owned entities only
ShareEntityDialog component properly shows all required fields
SharedWith component exists but only visible when entity has active shares
